        components = path.split('/')

        component = components[i]

        if component == '' or component == '.':
            i += 1
            continue

        if component == '..':

                current = current.rsplit('/', 1)[0]
                if current == '':
                    current = '/'
            i += 1
            continue

        if current == '/':
            current = '/' + component
        else:
            current = current + '/' + component

            links_followed += 1
            if links_followed > max_links:
                return None

            remaining = components[i + 1:]
            
            # Parse target components
            if target.startswith('/'):
                current = '/'
                target_components = target[1:].split('/')

                # Target is relative to the directory containing the link
                if current != '/':
                    current = current.rsplit('/', 1)[0]
                    if current == '':
                        current = '/'
                target_components = target.split('/')
            
            # Combine target components with remaining components
            components = target_components + remaining
            i = 0
            continue
        
        i += 1
    
    # Return result without trailing slash (except for '/')
    return current
